| # CAN-FD parameter configuration {#can-fd-parameter-configuration-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                       |                                                                                                                                                                 |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This topic explains the configuration of relevant parameters for the signal-based CAN-FD module on eC.

The following parameters can be configured from eC: some parameters are updated directly from the .dbc file, while the remaining mandatory parameters need to be filled in by the user.

## Frame Details {#frame-details .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

1.Direction

  ---------------- --------------- -------------- ------------------ -------------------- --------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range          Description        Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Direction        \-              send/receive   Frame direction.   Yes                  Imported from dbc.
  ---------------- --------------- -------------- ------------------ -------------------- --------------------

2.Frame Id

+----------------+---------------+-------------------+-------------------+--------------------+--------------------+
| Parameter Name | Default Value | Range             | Description       | Mandatory (Yes/No) | Other remarks      |
+----------------+---------------+-------------------+-------------------+--------------------+--------------------+
| Frame Id       | \-            | 0 - 0x1FFFFFFF or | Frame message ID. | Yes                | Imported from dbc. |
|                |               |                   |                   |                    |                    |
|                |               | 0 -- 0x7FF        |                   |                    |                    |
+----------------+---------------+-------------------+-------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

3.Name

+----------------+---------------+-----------+---------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Parameter Name | Default Value | Range     | Description                     | Mandatory (Yes/No) | Other remarks                                                            |
+----------------+---------------+-----------+---------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Frame Name     | \-            | \-        | Frame name as available in DBC. | Yes                | Imported from dbc.\                                                      |
|                |               |           |                                 |                    | The name should be alphanumeric, and special characters are not allowed. |
+----------------+---------------+-----------+---------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+

4.Length

  ---------------- --------------- ---------------------------------------- ------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range                                    Description                     Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Frame Length     \-              1- 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, 64 bytes   Length of the frame in bytes.   Yes                  Imported from dbc.
  ---------------- --------------- ---------------------------------------- ------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------

5.CAN Id Type

+----------------+---------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------+
| Parameter Name | Default Value | Range                | Description                          | Mandatory (Yes/No) | Other remarks      |
+----------------+---------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------+
| CAN Id Type    | \-            | Standard/ Extended/\ | CAN ID type for the selected frame . | Yes                | Imported from dbc. |
|                |               | Standard_FD/\        |                                      |                    |                    |
|                |               | Extended_FD          |                                      |                    |                    |
+----------------+---------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

6.User Callout

+----------------+---------------+-----------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+
| Parameter Name | Default Value | Range     | Description                                                                                                                                                              | Mandatory (Yes/No) | Other remarks                   |
+----------------+---------------+-----------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+
| User Callout   | \-            | \-        | By providing a function with the specified callout name further functionalities can be defined by the user. This function is called every time a new PDU is transmitted. | No                 | Needs to be configured by user. |
|                |               |           |                                                                                                                                                                          |                    |                                 |
|                |               |           |                                                                                                                                                                          |                    |                                 |
+----------------+---------------+-----------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+

7.Timeout Period

+----------------+---------------+----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+
| Parameter Name | Default Value | Range          | Description                                                              | Mandatory (Yes/No) | Other remarks                   |
+----------------+---------------+----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+
| Timeout Period | 0             | 0-3600 seconds | Defines the length of the deadline monitoring timeout period in seconds. | No                 | Needs to be configured by user. |
|                |               |                |                                                                          |                    |                                 |
|                |               |                | Up to two decimal points are allowed. Example: 0.15 sec                  |                    |                                 |
+----------------+---------------+----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+

8.First Timeout Period

+----------------------+---------------+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+
| Parameter Name       | Default Value | Range          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Mandatory (Yes/No) | Other remarks                   |
+----------------------+---------------+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+
| First Timeout Period | 0             | 0-3600 seconds | Defines the length of the initial deadline monitoring timeout period in seconds. This timeout is applied immediately after the start (or restart) of the deadline monitoring service. The timeout period for subsequent intervals is configured by the Timeout Period parameter. | No                 | Needs to be configured by user. |
|                      |               |                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                    |                                 |
|                      |               |                | Up to two decimal points are allowed. Example: 0.01 sec                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                    |                                 |
+----------------------+---------------+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+---------------------------------+

9.Timeout Callout

  ----------------- --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name    Default Value   Range   Description                                                                                                                                                                Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Timeout Callout   \-              \-      By providing a function with the specified callout name further functionalities can be defined by the user. The function is called every time a PDU timeout is detected.   No                   Needs to be configured by user.
  ----------------- --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------

## 10. Tx Mode {#tx-mode .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ---------------- --------------- ------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range               Description                                                 Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Tx Mode          \-              Direct / Periodic   The available transmission modes are Direct and Periodic.   Yes                  Needs to be configured by user.
  ---------------- --------------- ------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------

## 10.1 Tx Mode - Direct {#tx-mode---direct .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The below attributes should be available for selection only if Tx Mode value is Direct.

## 10.1.1 Tx Mode No. of Repetitions {#tx-mode-no.-of-repetitions .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ---------------------------- --------------- ------- --------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name               Default Value   Range   Description                                                           Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Tx Mode No. of Repetitions   \-              1-255   Defines the number of repetitions for the transmission mode DIRECT.   Yes                  Needs to be configured by user.
  ---------------------------- --------------- ------- --------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------

## 10.1.2 Tx Mode Repetition Period {#tx-mode-repetition-period .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  --------------------------- --------------- ------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name              Default Value   Range        Description                                                                                                                                                                       Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Tx Mode Repetition Period   \-              10-3600000   Defines the repetition period in milliseconds of the multiple transmissions in case Tx Mode No. of repetitions is configured greater than 1 and TxMode is configured to DIRECT.   No                   Needs to be configured by user.
  --------------------------- --------------- ------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------

 

10.2 Tx Mode - Periodic

The below attributes should be available for selection only if Tx Mode value is Periodic.

## 10.2.1 Tx Mode Time Period {#tx-mode-time-period .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  --------------------- --------------- ------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name        Default Value   Range        Description                                                                                                                     Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Tx mode Time Period   \-              10-3600000   Defines the repetition period in milliseconds of the periodic transmission requests in case TxMode is configured to PERIODIC.   Yes                  Needs to be configured by user.
  --------------------- --------------- ------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------

## 10.2.2 Tx Mode Time Offset {#tx-mode-time-offset .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  --------------------- --------------- ------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name        Default Value   Range        Description                                                                                             Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Tx Mode Time Offset   \-              10-3600000   Defines the period in milliseconds between the start of the frame and the first transmission request.   No                   Needs to be configured by user.
  --------------------- --------------- ------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------

## Signal Details: {#signal-details .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

1.Name

  ---------------- --------------- -------- ------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------

  ---------------- --------------- -------- ------------------------- -------------------- -----------------------------------------------

| Signal Datatype | \-            | signed(-)/  | Defines the signal datatype. \'+\' indicates an unsigned signal datatype, and \'-\' indicates a signed datatype. | Yes                | Imported from dbc. |
|                 |               |             |                                                                                                                  |                    |                    |
|                 |               | unsigned(+) |                                                                                                                  |                    |                    |

## 6. Event Transfer Signal {#event-transfer-signal .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ----------------------- ----------------- ------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name          Default Value     Range                                 Description                                                                                                            Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Event Transfer Signal   Transfer_Always   Transfer_Always /Transfer-on-Change   Event trigger property for direct signal. Should be configurable only for direct signal and N.A for Periodic signal.   Yes                  Needs to be configured by user.
  ----------------------- ----------------- ------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------------------

## 7. Signal Groups {#signal-groups .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Addition, deletion, and updating of signal groups are possible on eC.

- Signals to be added to a signal group must be selected from the Signal Group dropdown in eC.

## Event Transfer Signal group {#event-transfer-signal-group .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ----------------------------- ----------------- ------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------ -------------------- ---------------------------------
  Parameter Name                Default Value     Range                                 Description                                Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Event Transfer Signal Group   Transfer_Always   Transfer_Always /Transfer-on-Change   Event trigger property for signal group.   Yes                  Needs to be configured by user.
  ----------------------------- ----------------- ------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------ -------------------- ---------------------------------
